title: Blue-Green Bridging Cheatsheet + Sprint Rollforward Runway (July 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This note captures a compact, actionable cheatsheet for performing a blue->green bridge cutover for the July sprint delivery. It is intentionally concise: runway timeline, preflight checklist, phased traffic bridge, smoke tests, rollback decision points, release-notes draft, and open items for follow-up.

Context and constraints:
- Target audience: release leads, SRE, oncall, QA, tech PMs.
- Deployment style: blue/green with traffic bridging (gradual shift via edge LB + feature flags).
- Business window: low-traffic overnight (PDT) but needs <1% error surface; some customers on Dedicated plans require circuit notifications.
- Dependents: feature-flag service, token-cache service, distributed KV.

Objectives (what good looks like):
- Successful cutover with no customer-facing errors > 5 min and < 0.5% p50 latency regression for 30m post-cutover.
- Automated rollback trigger if error rate > 2% sustained for 3m or latency p95 increases > 40% vs baseline.
- Clear comms and documented postmortem if any gate breaches.

Rollout calendar (compact runway):
- D-3 (2026-07-02): Final smoke test definitions, canary traffic plan, and telemetry dashboards locked. Owners: Maya (release lead), Priya (SRE).
- D-1 (2026-07-04): Dry run of bridge in staging (same LB rules). Confirm canary automations. Owners: Lucas (qa lead), Ethan (infra).
- Cutover day (2026-07-05) 02:00-04:00 PDT: Execute phased bridge (detailed below). War room open 01:30.
- +30m, +2h, +24h checkpoints: Telemetry review and decision windows.

Preflight checklist (must pass before starting):
- [ ] All blocking PRs merged and main build green (GH-PR-3421)
- [ ] Upgrade/compat test jobs passed on main in last 24h (CI: release-suite)
- [ ] Canaries defined: 100m req/s and slow-path coverage (qa: canary-cases-2026-07)
- [ ] Traffic-shift runbook accessible and the load balancer test token ready
- [ ] Feature-flag toggles created with owner and safe-defaults (FF: rollout/bridge-jul-2026)
- [ ] Notification list compiled (product, support, sales) and pre-written email/Slack templates
- [ ] Oncall rota confirmed and secondary SRE identified for escalation
- [ ] Telemetry dashboards live (errors, latency, user-facing 5xx, token cache hitrate)
- [ ] Baseline metrics snapshot saved (p50/p95 latency, error rate, env-specific throughput)

Phased bridge procedure (step-by-step):
1) Warm green: deploy new release to green infra, run health checks and golden tests (runbook step 3.1).
   - Wait for all pods healthy AND KV replication lag < 200ms.
2) Smoke internal traffic: route internal-only traffic (10%) for 10m to green. Verify no error regressions.
3) Canary traffic ramp: 0% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% ~ 5-10m windows. Between steps, wait 3m stable for key metrics.
4) Bridge mode: enable LB-level mirroring for 50% of sessions while still primarily serving blue. This runs for 10m to validate stateful flows.
5) De-synchronize caches: if token-cache TTLs differ, run cache-warm script to pre-populate green caches before 50% session routing.
6) Full switch: if all gates satisfied, flip LB weight to 100% green and demote blue to standby.

Gates and telemetry (pass/fail conditions):
- Error rate gate: rollback if user-facing errors > 2% sustained for 3 minutes.
- Latency gate: rollback if p95 latency increases > 40% compared to baseline for 5 minutes.
- Functional gate: top-10 user journeys must have success rate > 99.5% across canary window.
- Integration gate: 3rd-party call failure rate must not exceed baseline by more than 1%.

Rollback plan (fast path):
- Trigger conditions: any gate failure or critical customer report.
- Action: revert LB weight to blue 100% (automated playbook: lb-revert.sh), mark green nodes as draining, and open incident with severity tag.
- Post-rollback: collect runbook logs, capture trace samples, and create an incident ticket JIRA-REL-8123.

Smoke test catalog (quick checklist):
- Auth: login, token refresh, multi-device session test
- Core text generation: sample prompt through API (response length 50–150 tokens), verify 200 OK and non-empty output
- KV consistency: write-then-read roundtrip under 2s
- Streaming: single client streaming connect/disconnect test
- Edge LB: sticky session validation for session affinity flows

Runbook snippets (commands / playbook pointers):
- Check green health: kubectl -n prod get pods -l release=green --watch
- Dump canary traces: obs query --since 10m --tag canary=bridge-jul-2026
- Flip LB: infra/lb-tools set-weight --pool green --weight 100 || infra/lb-tools revert
- Rollback quick: infra/lb-tools set-weight --pool blue --weight 100 && notify #release-alerts

Communications (timing & templates):
- 01:00 PDT: Heads-up to ops@ and #eng-release (post: pre-cutover checklist passed)
- 01:30 PDT: War room open (link + attendee list)
- 02:05 PDT: Canary 2% -> notification to stakeholders with early metrics
- 03:15 PDT: Full-switch summary and release notes (if green) to eng-all + support

Release notes (draft - to be trimmed for public release):
- Short summary: "July release: improved inference batching, LB resiliency updates, and token-cache performance optimizations. Blue-Green deployment performed with staged bridge to minimize customer impact."
- Notable changes for customers: "No action required. Dedicated customers with IP allowlists: ensure edge IP ranges unchanged; if you use allowlisted session origins, please verify after 24h."
- Internal notes: list of PRs and services touched (GH-PR-3421, infra/kv-migrate-#729).
- Known issues: minor increase in debug logs from feature flag service (low severity), metric name change for generation.latency -> generation.lat_ms (observability team aware)

After-action checklist (+24h):
- [ ] 24h metrics review and any required mitigations recorded
- [ ] Tag release commit and create changelog entry
- [ ] Postmortem template pre-filled if any gate was triggered
- [ ] Remove temporary TTL overrides and cleanup canary toggles

Open decisions / unresolved items:
- Which customer IP allowlist cadence do we use for future bridges? (Priya to propose by 2026-07-15)
- Decide whether to automate the 50% session mirror step in infra tooling (Lucas + Ethan to prototype).
- Action: update Confluence entry with the final gate thresholds after this sprint run.

Appendix: quick links and pointers:
- Canary test suite: internal-ci://jobs/canary-bridge-2026-07
- War room link (temp): https://zoom.company/warroom-bridge-jul-2026
- Incident runbook template: confluence://runbooks/incident-template

Notes to reviewer:
- This doc should be used as the compact single page runbook for the night-of cutover. If you spot missing checks for any dependent service you own, annotate inline and ping the release channel.

Draft sign-off:
- Release lead: Maya Chen (pending)
- SRE secondary: Priya Singh (pending)
- QA sign-off: Lucas Morgan (pending)
